author: GamingBolt
description:
Happy endings are few and far between in the Resident Evil universe, but Requiem seems to be a major exception. Without delving into spoilers, the good guys effectively won, and the so-called “secret” of Raccoon City – including the quarantine that's seemingly been ongoing since it was bombed – was revealed to all and sundry.

That doesn't mean there weren't a fair number of loose ends, though, and you'd think the development team would address some of those in the upcoming paid expansion. However, in keeping with rumors that it's going for a much more ambitious scope, one story aspect has seemingly been confirmed by none other than writer Haris Orkin. During Meadowlark Comic Con, he revealed that he's working on Requiem's DLC.
title: Resident Evil Requiem Just Dropped Its BIGGEST DLC Hint Yet

author: GamingBolt
description:
Castlevania is back, and this time Konami has handed the reins over to Evil Empire, the studio behind Dead Cells’ acclaimed Return to Castlevania expansion. 

Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse, then, is a tantalising reunion, with the developer able to put their own spin on one of gaming’s most storied series. From protagonists to traversal tools and arcane magic, here are fifteen things you need to know before you buy.
title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
Dragon’s Dogma 2 was a fun yet slightly flawed title back in the day, but the developer has done well to make it everything it was meant to be with a comprehensive title update and a new expansion that can easily feel like it’s a showcase of what the game was always meant to be. 

It brings interesting new systems to work alongside the expansion to existing ones, creating a synchronicity between exploring the new frozen world of Norgan and taking on the insane new levels of challenge it brings to the table. 

It’s a balance between fresh touches and familiar elements that works well enough to make this one an expansion worth your time and money if you’re into games that make you earn the rewards they dole out.
title: Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Review - A Fantastic Expansion You Need To Play

author: GamingBolt
description:
For a game that takes so much clear inspiration from so many places, Silver Pines remarkably stands out on its own. It takes a relatively standard atmospheric horror setup and layers on top of it both a unique concoction of gameplay elements and genres and a remarkable presentation, and the way that all elements play off of each other elevate the atmosphere of the entire package. 

It can be a bit obtuse at points with its clues and certainly allows you to wander a bit too much too quickly, but it makes up for it with rewarding exploration, an intriguing world, and a great sense of cleverness in its progression.
title: Silver Pines PS5 Review - This Awesome Game Came Out of Nowhere
